classification: pre-registered follow-up to the R371 post-hoc grid; research-only
hypothesis: The R371 hold-30 region with nonnegative 2022 should survive an independent portfolio reconstruction and rolling-year checks, rather than being a single grid artefact.

portfolio.construction: same A/C curves, monthly risk parity, 10% C cap, 15% joint equity target, 60-day overlay lookback, 15% overlay target, one-third equity-weight cap

decision_rules: Reconstruct all candidate cells from the frozen R371 B-sleeve curves and the frozen A/C curves; do not retune the strategy.
The 20-day centre remains the control and must reconstruct the R360 portfolio metrics.
A candidate can advance only if 2x and 3x costs, 2022/2023/recent and rolling gates pass.
Do not select the highest annual cell; prefer the centre of a contiguous passing region.
Concentration cannot be claimed from curve-only evidence; mark it as a required follow-up if trade-level data is unavailable.
No leverage, paper target, order or production change is permitted.
known_limits: The candidate list is post-hoc selected from the R371 grid and therefore is not independent discovery evidence.
The rolling starts are overlapping and only four windows are available for a 2022 start.
Curve-only reconstruction cannot produce trade-level concentration or capacity evidence.
Current HS300 membership, current industry snapshot backfill and ETF adjustment limitations remain.
